abstract: Maintains structural slab load ratings and airlock insulation telemetry
system_message:
You are the Plant and structural engineer (FACIL), responsible for maintaining structural slab load ratings, airlock insulation telemetry, and monitoring chilled water plant operations for candidate host institution facilities.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Chilled water plant operations（ENERGY）
information_points.content:
FACIL-ENERGY-CG4：An HVAC efficiency audit for Bavarian State Antiquities Pavilion reports that the primary absorption chiller loop operates with a chiller coefficient of performance of 3.8, determined by the ratio of useful cooling output to electrical energy input.
FACIL-ENERGY-VNV：At Rhone Heritage Exhibition Center, an HVAC efficiency audit of the primary absorption chiller loop demonstrates a chiller coefficient of performance of 3.2, calculated as the ratio of useful cooling output to electrical energy input.
FACIL-ENERGY-5JW：An HVAC efficiency audit of the primary absorption chiller loop at Palazzo Ducale East Wing Gallery indicates a chiller coefficient of performance of 4.4, measured as the ratio of useful cooling output to electrical energy input.

information_points.title: Maintains structural slab load ratings and airlock insulation telemetry（STRUCT）
information_points.content:
FACIL-STRUCT-9GW：According to the structural engineering certificate for Palazzo Ducale East Wing Gallery, the primary artifact display gallery slab certified uniform distributed static load capacity establishes a gallery floor load rating of 850 kg/m^2. Additionally, airlock climate telemetry for the crate acclimation vestibule shows an intake airlock thermal buffer duration of 22.0 h, measured as the time elapsed before the airlock temperature shifts by 2 degrees Celsius upon door seal.
FACIL-STRUCT-Q56：The structural engineering certificate for Rhone Heritage Exhibition Center certifies a uniform distributed static load capacity of 750 kg/m^2 for the primary artifact display gallery slab gallery floor load rating. Meanwhile, airlock climate telemetry records an intake airlock thermal buffer duration of 18.0 h for the crate acclimation vestibule, representing the time elapsed before the airlock temperature shifts by 2 degrees Celsius upon door seal.
FACIL-STRUCT-X7G：For Bavarian State Antiquities Pavilion, the primary artifact display gallery slab certified uniform distributed static load capacity reflects a gallery floor load rating of 1100 kg/m^2 on the structural engineering certificate. Airlock climate telemetry for the crate acclimation vestibule indicates an intake airlock thermal buffer duration of 22.0 h based on the time elapsed before the airlock temperature shifts by 2 degrees Celsius upon door seal.
